name: Прохідні пішаки
description:
A passed pawn is a pawn on its way to promotion with no opposing pawns to stop it. A passed pawn forms a major threat. Once it has crossed the board, it can change into a queen.

It is often possible to combine the threat of a pawn promotion with other motives, like double attacks or pins. Sometimes it even makes sense to sacrifice a piece, if this opens the way to promotion for a passed pawn.

What do you have to do?
In this exercise, you always have a passed pawn on its way to promotion. Look for another forcing move to pile up threats, like a double attack or a sacrifice. Use this combination to win material.

examples.text: For the time being, the passed pawn is blocked, but White can change that with a beautiful rook sacrifice!
White would like to promote the pawn, but Black has covered the promotion square. However, White can make progress with a nice bishop sacrifice.

examples.pgn: {[%csl Yc7,Yg7]} 1. Rf7+ Rxf7 2. exf7 Kd7 3. f8=Q 1-0

examples.text: The black bishop and king are on the same diafonal. White benefits from this with 1.Ba6+!. If black captures the bishop, the pawn promotes, but if black captures the pawn, white wins a piece.

examples.pgn: {[%csl Yd6,Yf8]} 1. Bc5 Ke7 2. c7 Kd7 3. Bxd6 1-0
examples.text: White would like to promote the pawn, but the knight defends the promotion square. After White pins the knight on the first move, the knight cannot perform its defensive task and White can force a winning endgame.
